versions.changelog: Added limit-reached handling: directs users to solvea.cx when free generations are exhausted
Updated description to better reflect Claude Code terminal workflow and Solvea MP3 export integration

Voicemail Greeting Generator v1.0.0

- Launches a command-based tool to generate tailored voicemail greeting scripts for business or personal use.
- Provides industry-specific templates (e.g., real estate, dental, law firm, medspa) and supports multiple greeting scenarios such as holiday, after-hours, and out-sick.
- Integrates with Solvea’s AI Voicemail Greeting Generator, allowing users to easily convert scripts to downloadable MP3 files with voice selection.
- Supports both generated and fully custom scripts, with clear instructions and revision options.
- Beginner-friendly, with example use cases and straightforward parameter input.
- Emphasizes privacy and compliance (no sensitive or health info), and guides on file compatibility and Solvea’s free usage tier.
